summary: Iteration 27 backend + frontend testing complete. Backend pytest: 9/10 PASS. Frontend UI + realtime E2E: 8/8 PASS. Found 1 CRITICAL backend bug: POST /api/settings/ silently drops the new fields (seo_title, seo_description, ui_texts, address_suggestions_enabled, order_auto_cancel_minutes) because they are missing from the SettingsUpdate Pydantic model. All other new features work: public settings expose new fields, /api/logs/client works no-auth, orders/create accepts empty/missing house_number, auto-cancel via expire_stale_pending_orders sets cancelled_by='timeout', my-active returns recently finished order (<3 min) then {status:none}, drivers/stats correctly excludes stale online drivers (>120s), heartbeat via GET /api/orders/active updates last_seen_at, full E2E order flow (customer create -> driver accept -> customer sees accepted with driver_name -> complete) works. Frontend: landing 'Найти поездку' subtitle present, /auth/customer heading OK, /auth/driver has 2 checkboxes and Продолжить disabled until both checked, /auth/pin shows 'Забыли код? Восстановить' (без 'через SMS'), /customer shows 'Адрес и номер дома' + 'Уточнение' + 'Разместить заказ' with NO address dropdown, order created without 'Уточнение' works. CRITICAL REALTIME FIX VERIFIED: customer stays on /customer, order gets accepted via API, screen transitions to 'Исполнитель найден!' with 'Позвонить исполнителю' button within ~500ms of polling; after complete via API, screen transitions to 'Поездка завершена' without reload. Admin /admin/login -> Настройки shows 'Тексты интерфейса' block (12 ui-text-* fields), settings-seo-title, settings-seo-description, settings-address-suggestions, settings-auto-cancel-minutes present. Backend URL: https://order-sync-platform-1.preview.emergentagent.com. NOTE: because of the SettingsUpdate bug, saving from admin panel will show 'saved' toast but new fields will NOT actually persist — need to fix Pydantic model before admin can meaningfully edit these values.

critical.issue: SettingsUpdate Pydantic model (server.py L192-248) is missing the new fields seo_title, seo_description, ui_texts, address_suggestions_enabled, order_auto_cancel_minutes. Pydantic v2 default ignores extra fields, so admin POSTs with these keys return 200 but the values are silently dropped and never written to Mongo. Verified: POST {seo_title:'X', ui_texts:{k:'V'}, address_suggestions_enabled:true, order_auto_cancel_minutes:17} -> settings/public still returns '' / {} / false and admin settings/ still returns null for order_auto_cancel_minutes.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded 'Ищем водителя...' at line 631 does NOT use getText(settings,'searching_title'). Admin cannot override this text via ui_texts.searching_title as intended by UI_TEXT_DEFS. Also references 'водителя' while the rest of the app uses 'исполнитель'.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add missing fields to SettingsUpdate Pydantic model in /app/backend/server.py L192-248: seo_title: Optional[str]=None; seo_description: Optional[str]=None; ui_texts: Optional[Dict[str, str]]=None; address_suggestions_enabled: Optional[bool]=None; order_auto_cancel_minutes: Optional[int]=None. (Alternatively: add model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow') to accept arbitrary keys, but explicit fields are safer.)

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsUpdate model must be kept in sync with settings/public whenever new admin-editable fields are introduced — the current pattern of freely reading settings.get(...) in settings/public but relying on a strict Pydantic model in POST is error-prone. Consider using model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow') or a dict-based endpoint.

rca of the issue: Root cause of settings persistence bug: When new admin-editable fields (seo_title, seo_description, ui_texts as dict, address_suggestions_enabled, order_auto_cancel_minutes) were added to /api/settings/public (server.py L2635-2638) and to the AdminPanel UI (frontend testids ui-text-*, settings-seo-*, settings-address-suggestions, settings-auto-cancel-minutes), the SettingsUpdate Pydantic model at server.py L192-248 was not updated. FastAPI validates the request body against this model and Pydantic v2 silently drops unknown keys by default. The endpoint at L2573 uses `data.model_dump()` which only contains the declared fields, so the new keys never reach `db.settings.update_one($set)`. FIX: Add these Optional fields to SettingsUpdate: `seo_title: Optional[str] = None`, `seo_description: Optional[str] = None`, `ui_texts: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None`, `address_suggestions_enabled: Optional[bool] = None`, `order_auto_cancel_minutes: Optional[int] = None`. Add `Dict` to imports from typing if not present.
